title: Sr. Research Associate I
description:
**Jubilant Drug Discovery and Development Services (JDDDS)** 
 , is part of the Jubilant LifeSciences family of companies with R\&D Centers in India, USA and business offices in Asia, Europe and North America. JDDDS has a global reach and provides comprehensive drug discovery and development solutions from target discovery to clinical development in partnership with leading pharma companies worldwide.
   

  

 With clear scientific focus in Oncology, Metabolic Disorders, CNS and Pain and Inflammation, JDDDS has rapidly emerged as a leading collaborator for pharma industry. In each of these therapeutic areas, Jubilant has developed a depth of expertise in discovery informatics, medicinal chemistry, structural biology, biology, in vitro, in vivo models and translational sciences. Combined with strong clinical development and manufacturing capabilities, Jubilant has emerged as a fully integrated company with end\-to\-end solution for pharma industry.
   

  

 JDDDS business constitutes three Jubilant subsidiaries, Jubilant Biosys (Drug discovery services), Jubilant Chemsys (Chemistry services) and Jubilant Clinsys (Clinical trial services). With over 1200 highly skilled and experienced scientific and medical personnel spread across Bangalore and Noida in India, Europe and the US, the JDDDS vertical leverages the capabilities in emerging markets for a global outcome, accelerating the global drug development efforts.

title: B2B Growth / Performance Marketer
description:
Our sister company, Capital Placement, is a dual\-sided marketplace. Employers on one side, early\-career talent on the other, and our job is to match the two. At CP, our sales team currently owns the full employer cycle from lead generation to close, leaning heavily on cold outbound. We're good at it, but we're getting close to hitting the ceiling of what outbound alone can do. Deliverability is harder, inboxes are crowded, and great prospects are tuning out. We are now looking for a B2B Growth Manager who can help us reach more employers and build a team around them to help them do so in the coming months. 
 



 That's where you come in. We're looking for a Growth Marketer with B2B experience to build our inbound engine from the ground up. Your job is to bring us employers who already want to hire an intern or graduate, so sales can focus on closing rather than opening. You'll own the systems, campaigns, and automated workflows that make it happen, working across paid ads, retargeting, email, marketing automation, AI tools. Does this sound like a challenge you'd take on? If so, keep reading.
 


**Responsibilities** 
* Create a plan that brings in leads in the first 30 days and keeps growing over the next 6 to 12 months
* Run paid ads and retargeting campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other platforms, putting budget where it actually converts
* Build email nurture, lead scoring, and automation workflows that route high\-intent leads to sales in real time
* Build and release landing pages to attract the right audience, and A/B test to optimise
* Make Capital Placement visible in AI search (ChatGPT, Gemini) through structured data, citations, and Answer Engine Optimisation.
* Track the full funnel from first visit to closed deal, and use the data to decide what to improve
* Work closely with sales to agree on what a good lead looks like and keep improving the handoff
* Lay the groundwork to build a team around you in the next 6 \-12 months


**What we're looking for** 
* A self\-starter who builds solutions when they don't already exist
* 2\+years building inbound marketing engines from scratch at a
 **B2B startup, owning the strategy as well as the execution**
* Hands\-on with paid ads on Google, LinkedIn, and Meta (including retargeting), and you've experimented enough to know what works and what doesn't
* Email and marketing automation experience
* Day\-to\-day use of sales engagement and enrichment tools like Clay, Apollo, and Instantly
* Comfortable with data and building dashboards
* Extensive experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to automate your workflow, spin up copy, build landing pages, and more


**Bonus points** 
* Experience in recruiting, edtech, early\-career, or marketplace startups
* Experience marketing to B2B buyers in the UK, UAE, or other Western markets
